title: The Late Bakery Revisited
premise: Freya Brightwater ghostwrites the memoirs of celebrity baker Marcus Vale, whose flagship bakery occupies the lease she secretly holds on her late mother's shop next door. When Julian Ashe—the pen pal who wrote her anonymous letters for a decade, never knowing he was writing to the woman his testimony once ruined—moves in upstairs, Freya must decide whether to expose Marcus's stolen recipes and lose the career that rebuilt her life. At the lease signing, she chooses truth over safety, publishing the memoir under her own name with Julian's letters woven through it; they reopen the bakery together as partners in work and love.
about_author: E. M. Fairweather is the pen name of a former pastry chef turned novelist who spent years writing other people's stories before claiming one of her own. She lives above a small bakery, where the smell of morning bread remains her favorite plot device.

chapters.title: Proofing
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. Ghostwriting Marcus Vale's charming memoir by day, Freya discovers the lease on her mother's old bakery—her secret anchor—expires in ninety days, and Marcus intends to absorb the space. A moving truck arrives next door: Julian Ashe, the letter-writer she's loved from behind anonymity for ten years. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath fragile new hope.

chapters.title: The Letters Between Us
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Julian recognizes Freya's phrasing from their letters and confronts her gently; old intimacy reignites even as she hides her role in his past ruin. Meanwhile she finds proof Marcus stole the very recipes credited to him—recipes born in her mother's kitchen. Emotional beat: warmth deepening into complicity and fear.

chapters.title: What the Yeast Knows
chapters.summary: Julian's POV. Julian learns Freya was the girl his testimony harmed a decade ago—and that Marcus engineered both their downfalls to seize the bakery block. He offers to testify with her, but Marcus threatens to bury them with the ghostwriting contract's confidentiality clause. Emotional beat: betrayal curdling into resolve; love against duty at full pressure.

chapters.title: First Batch
chapters.summary: Freya's POV. At the lease signing, Freya publicly claims authorship of the memoir, inserting the letters and the recipe evidence, collapsing Marcus's empire and her own safe invisibility in one stroke. Weeks later, flour on their hands, she and Julian reopen the bakery under both their names. Emotional beat: costly truth rewarded; loyalty and love finally aligned.
